purpose.zh: 在椅子上放松髋内旋，适合久坐时做
purpose.en: Ease into hip internal rotation from your chair, ideal for desk breaks.

text.zh: 脚踩稳，一侧膝盖慢慢向内倒
text.en: Keep your feet planted and let one knee tip slowly inward

text.zh: 坐在椅子前三分之一，双脚比髋宽
text.en: Sit on the front third of the chair with feet wider than your hips.

text.zh: 停一下回到中间，再换另一侧
text.en: Pause, come back to center, then switch sides.

commonErrors.zh: 双膝碰在一起或用力压
commonErrors.en: Forcing the knee in or letting the knees touch.
Leaning the body with the knee.

cautions.zh: 膝或髋疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your knees or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
